messages.text:
"Create a 2D top-down spinning top battle game inspired by Beyblade. Set the battle inside a circular stadium arena with sloped edges that push tops toward the center. The player controls a blue metallic spinning top with touch drag or joystick, fighting against a red CPU rival top. Each top has a spin stamina bar that drains when colliding or hitting walls. Collisions must create bright sparks, metallic clash sound effects, and knockback physics. Include a special attack button that unleashes a glowing Pegasus star blast dash when charged. You win by knocking the rival out of the stadium or making it stop spinning first.\"

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
